dos.title: Drive on the left side of the road
dos.description: Mauritius drives on the LEFT (UK-style); remember roundabouts give way to traffic from the right.

dos.title: Respect sacred Hindu shrines and temples
dos.description: Remove shoes and leather items when visiting sacred temple areas such as Grand Bassin (Ganga Talao).

dos.title: Try local street food delicacies
dos.description: Sample Mauritian dhal puri, samosas, and boulettes at local beach kiosks and Port Louis Central Market.

donts.title: Don't purchase or collect shells and coral from reefs
donts.description: Taking corals, sea stars, or large marine shells from lagoons is strictly illegal under environmental protection laws.

donts.title: Don't bring rolling papers without tobacco
donts.description: Customs strictly inspects rolling papers and cigarette accessories due to tight anti-contraband regulations.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping is not mandatory but 5-10% is customary in restaurants and resorts for attentive service.
